name: Netherlands – Transition Payment Policy.md
content:
## Entitlement
An employee in the Netherlands whose contract is ended by the employer is entitled to a transition payment (transitievergoeding) from the first day of employment.
The payment is one third of the monthly salary per full year of service, calculated pro rata for partial years.
## Cap
The transition payment is capped at €98,000 in 2026 or one annual salary if that is higher.
## Processing
Register the termination in the payroll engine with reason code TV and the engine calculates the amount from the salary history.

name: Germany – Minimum Wage 2026 Checklist.md
content:
## January run
The statutory minimum wage in Germany is €13.90 per hour from 1 January 2026.
Check every hourly wage type below €13.90 in SAP Payroll before the January run and raise it to the minimum.
Mini-job earnings threshold moves to €603 per month accordingly; verify the Minijob flag for affected employees.
